governance.labState: Lab remains on feature/swc-think-fast-aca-dns with eight unrelated dirty/untracked paths. This sprint assigns no lab source edits, grants or branch switch. Owners commit explicit intended paths using git commit --only, preserving other staged work and originals, before original review. Same-branch commits are already integrated, not fabricated merges. Keep abandoned branches. RP-S1-SOURCE-CHECKS audits the outgoing reviewed set before push.
governance.fileOwnership: RP-S1-ID-HANDOFF exclusively owns identity analysis/script/fixtures/recovery text. RP-S1-ID-INTEGRATE takes index ownership after that handoff and owns focused reconciliation of completed task paths. governance.authority: Either supported authentication/configuration correction or x-ms-user-identity delegation may be selected from evidence. Necessary narrowly scoped lab permissions are pre-approved but must be documented and implemented/read back through reviewed deterministic lab tooling. No speculative grants, opaque-call-ID user substitution, infrastructure/network/quota mutation, provider submission, private evidence transfer or unknown-effect replay.
governance.execution: Use local repository scripts with explicit application/lab roots. No GitHub Actions. Bounded decision tests only in the selection assignment; formal integration acceptance remains EndToEndTestLoop and publication/cloud-pass remains DevOpsWorkLoop. New package requirements do not bypass source/Linux/package/review/publication gates.
governance.stopRule: Five consecutive rounds without reviewer-verified new progress stop blocked; productive rounds are uncapped. Do not count repeated historical research/tests or changed wording as progress. Genuine missing user authentication or provider-only information is reported exactly; material internal scope changes use needs-replan.
governance.estimates: Minutes are rough implementation/review/integration estimates, not execution limits or inferred concurrency/spend ceilings.
